title: Redstone Boost
description: A simple resource pack that enhances Minecraft’s redstone textures with cleaner details, brighter colors, and a smoother visual style.
body:
RedstoneBoost is a lightweight resource pack designed to improve the appearance of Minecraft’s redstone materials with cleaner textures, brighter colors, and subtle visual enhancements. The pack refreshes redstone-related blocks and items while maintaining a style that fits naturally within Minecraft’s vanilla look.

With smoother details and more noticeable redstone visuals, the pack helps create a cleaner and more polished appearance for builds, contraptions, and technical setups without changing gameplay mechanics. The enhanced textures are designed to remain simple and easy to recognize during normal gameplay.

Perfect for redstone builds, survival worlds, and technical gameplay, RedstoneBoost provides a refined visual upgrade for players who want a cleaner and more vibrant redstone experience. 🔴✨
